lines.en: label futabaspring1:
scene clearnightsky
To what do I owe this pleasure? That of traipsing down a faintly lit path just blocks away from the dorm as if this is where I’m meant to be...
lines.zh: 我何德何能享有这份荣幸？是那种沿着离宿舍只有几个街区、灯光昏暗的小路漫步的乐趣，就好像我本该属于这里……

lines.en: That of spending my night beside a lovable girl — yet a girl that I {i}can not{/i} love because I haven’t figured out how to yet.
lines.zh: 还是那种在一个可爱的女孩身边度过夜晚的乐趣——可那是个我还{i}无法{/i}去爱的女孩，因为我还没学会该怎么做。

lines.en: Maybe it would be easier if she wasn’t so nice to me.
lines.zh: 也许如果她没对我这么好，会容易一些。

lines.en: Maybe if she went on long-winded rants about how I’m the most disgusting man on the face of the earth...
lines.zh: 也许如果她会喋喋不休地数落我是这个世界上最恶心的男人……

lines.en: Or if she took me on tours of my childhood or...cut her hair in a fit of panicked rage because of my absence-
lines.zh: 或者带我重温我的童年，又或者……因为我的缺席而在惊恐的暴怒中剪掉自己的头发——

lines.en: Maybe then the love would come easier.
lines.zh: 也许那样，爱会来得容易些。

lines.en: I don’t know {i}why{/i} I’ve taken it upon myself to disperse my heaviest thoughts and feelings on those shouldering the most weight, but perhaps it has something to do with my affinity for destruction.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己{i}为什么{/i}总把最沉重的心思和感情，分摊给那些已经扛着最多重量的人——不过也许这和我对于破坏的偏爱有关。

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse1
Just thirty minutes ago, this same girl was calling me “Daddy.”
lines.zh: 就在三十分钟前，这同一个女孩还在叫我「爸爸」。

lines.en: She was riding my lap as if she was {i}bred{/i} to do that. And while that’s not something I’d encourage other prospective fathers out there to do, I’ll admit that it was quite invigorating.
lines.zh: 她骑在我腿上，就好像她{i}生来{/i}就是为了做这件事。虽然我不会鼓励其他那些准爸爸们也这么做，但我得承认，那确实让人精神焕发。

lines.en: But now comes the silence — that reflective retrospective and all that rides in on its shoulders, but not out of the affinity to destroy.
lines.zh: 但此刻沉默降临了——那段反思性的回溯，以及骑在它肩上的一切，不过这次不是出于对破坏的偏爱。

lines.en: It rides in that way because the weight serves to keep us grounded. It makes it feel as if we’re not floating away when all of the bubbles that exist within us as the result of a thing called “bliss” begin to lift us up.
lines.zh: 它是以那种方式进来的，因为那份重量能让我们脚踏实地。当那种叫作「极乐」的东西在我们体内生出的所有气泡开始把我们托起时，它让我们觉得自己并没有飘走。

lines.en: Typically speaking, I’m the one who habitually pops them as I’ve always had a fear of heights.
lines.zh: 一般而言，习惯性地戳破那些气泡的人是我，因为我一直都有恐高症。

lines.en: But on some nights when I’m spent, and I can guarantee you that tonight is one of those nights, I just can’t seem to find my needle.
lines.zh: 但在某些我精疲力竭的夜晚——我可以向你保证，今晚就是其中之一——我就是找不到我的针。

lines.en: I could burst them with my finger, I’m sure. But the idea of getting any of that joy all over my hands does nothing but make me want to wash them.
lines.zh: 我可以用手指戳破它们，我确信。可是一想到要把那份喜悦沾得满手都是，只会让我想去洗手。

lines.en: I wonder what we’ll talk about tonight.
lines.zh: 我好奇今晚我们会聊些什么。

lines.en: I wonder if it will make me like her more, or make me like her less.
lines.zh: 我好奇那会让我更喜欢她，还是更不喜欢她。

lines.en: I wonder if it even matters.
lines.zh: 我好奇这是否还有意义。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: Here it comes — that unwanted weight.
lines.zh: 来了——那份不请自来的重量。

lines.en: : Yeah?
: Tell me more about Ami.
lines.zh: : 多跟我说说 Ami 吧。

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse2
: Huh?
: Are you surprised that’s what I want to talk about?
lines.zh: : 你很惊讶我想聊的是这个吗？

lines.en: : Kind of, considering she’s public enemy number one for most people by now.
lines.zh: : 有点，毕竟到如今她在大多数人眼里已经是头号公敌了。

lines.en: : Love makes us do all sorts of crazy things. That in mind, I don’t really find anything Ami said all that “crazy.”
lines.zh: : 爱会让人做出各种各样的疯狂举动。这么一想，我倒真不觉得 Ami 说的那些话有多「疯狂」。

lines.en: : She threatened to dismember you.
lines.zh: : 她威胁要把你肢解了。

lines.en: : Yes, but do you really think she’d follow through with it?
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你真觉得她会说到做到吗？

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah.
lines.zh: : 有点觉得，嗯。

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse3
: Oh. Well, maybe my self-defense instinct isn’t all that functional then.
lines.zh: : 哦。那看来我的自卫本能也不怎么管用了。

lines.en: : But still, she’s the biggest change in your life lately. And I’m interested in hearing more about how things are shaping up now that I’m not distracted by...other things.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，她是最近你生命里最大的变化。而我现在不再被……别的事分心了，所以想多听听事情进展得怎么样。

lines.en: : You mean how you missed me so much that your body opened itself up to me the moment I showed up in your room?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你有多想我，以至于我一出现在你房间，你的身体就为我敞开了？

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse4
: Exactly. Though, I’d word it in a much less vulgar way since I’m still a good girl whether that’s how you prefer me or not.
lines.zh: : 正是。不过我会用不那么粗俗的方式说，因为不管你喜不喜欢，我依然是个好女孩。

lines.en: : I don’t have a preference. Futaba being Futaba is all that matters to me. And you were still Futaba even {i}if{/i} you were screaming and moaning about wanting Daddy’s cock to-
lines.zh: : 我没有什么偏好。Futaba 就是 Futaba，这才是我唯一在乎的。{i}就算{/i}你尖叫着、呻吟着说想要爸爸的鸡巴——你也还是 Futaba——

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse5
: Oh, look! A bench! Why don’t we go sit over there?
lines.zh: : 哦，看！有张长椅！我们过去坐那儿吧？

lines.en: : Sure. But I have a shift at the tire factory early tomorrow morning, so we’re going to have to make it quick.
lines.zh: : 好。不过我明天一早还要去轮胎工厂上班，所以我们得快点。

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse6
: Why did I even say that? I have no idea where it came from.
lines.zh: : 我干嘛要说那个？我完全不知道它从哪儿冒出来的。

lines.en: : Beats me. But hey, you saved me from having to come up with a backstory and I still got to fuck my daughter. So all’s good on my end.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。不过嘿，你省得我编背景故事了，而我照样操到了我的女儿。所以在我这边一切都好。

lines.en: scene black
: Well, hopefully being able to relate to the topic at hand won’t cause you to get as...{i}excited{/i} as I did earlier.
lines.zh: : 嗯，希望你能对眼前这个话题产生共鸣这件事，不会让你像我之前那样……{i}兴奋{/i}。

lines.en: : So you really {i}do{/i} want to fuck your dad, huh?
lines.zh: : 所以你是{i}真的{/i}想操你爸爸啊？

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse7
: Of course not! But in the context of a fictional setting where I am {i}not{/i} Futaba Fukuyama...maybe.
lines.zh: : 当然不是！不过在一个我{i}不是{/i} Futaba Fukuyama 的虚构设定里……也许是。

lines.en: : I’m just teasing you, don’t worry. It doesn’t matter to me who you want to sleep with.
lines.zh: : 我只是逗你玩的，别担心。你想和谁上床，对我不重要。

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse8
: Well, it should probably matter a {i}little.{/i} Because even if you’re seeing other girls, I’d like you to be {i}kind of{/i} possessive when it comes to me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，也许你该稍微在意{i}一点{/i}。因为就算你还在和别的女生来往，我也希望你在涉及到我的时候能{i}有点{/i}占有欲。

lines.en: : What right do I have to be possessive of anyone when I get more action from more girls than basically every other male left in Kumon-mi combined?
lines.zh: : 我上过的女生比 Kumon-mi 剩下的所有男人加起来还多，我有什么资格对任何人有占有欲？

lines.en: : None of this is making me feel good about myself, Sensei. I just think it’d be nice to know that the boy I’m interested in isn’t {i}okay{/i} with me sleeping around.
lines.zh: : 这些话一点都没让我对自己感觉好一点，Sensei。我只是觉得，如果能知道我喜欢的那个男生并不{i}赞成{/i}我到处乱睡，那会挺好的。

lines.en: : I know. I’m sorry. And I’m {i}not{/i} okay with that, for the record. I probably wouldn’t have even said that if I had any sort of real competition in this city.
lines.zh: : 我知道。抱歉。而且我得声明，我并{i}不{/i}赞成。如果我在这座城市里有哪怕一点真正的竞争对手，我大概都不会说那种话。

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse9
: That’s a little better...but still.
lines.zh: : 这稍微好一点了……但还是。

lines.en: : I promise I’m just as wholesome now as the day you met me.
lines.zh: : 我保证，我现在和你认识我那天一样纯洁健康。

lines.en: : I came inside of you like ten times tonight.
lines.zh: : 我今晚在你里面射了大概十次。

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse10
: That just means our baby will be very strong and healthy and there’s nothing to worry about at all.
lines.zh: : 那只能说明我们的宝宝会非常强壮健康，完全没什么好担心的。

lines.en: : Do you mind if I call the tire factory really quick? I need someone to cover for me tomorrow on account of the fact that I’m going to kill myself tonight.
lines.zh: : 介意我赶紧给轮胎工厂打个电话吗？我明天需要有人替我的班，因为我今晚就要去自杀了。

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse11
: What's wrong, Sensei? Is {i}two{/i} children too many for you?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Sensei？{i}两个{/i}孩子对你来说太多了吗？

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse12
: What spurred this whole thing with Ami anyway? What was it that made you want to take that final step?
lines.zh: : 说起来，是什么促成了你和 Ami 之间的这一切？是什么让你想迈出那最后一步？

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse13
: I wonder how many people I’m going to have to talk to about this.
lines.zh: : 我在想，这件事我到底得跟多少人谈一遍。

lines.en: : Probably most of them. You’ve got a lot of people who really care about you, but you’ve always been a very...specific type of person to all of them. A change this big isn’t something you can just keep hidden.
lines.zh: : 大概是大多数。你身边有很多真心在乎你的人，但你对他们每个人来说，一直都是一种非常……特殊的存在。这么大的变化，不是你能藏得住的。

lines.en: : It’s not like I want to keep it hidden. I wouldn’t have told you in the first place if that was the case. I just don’t really know what it means when it comes to my relationship with everyone else.
lines.zh: : 我又不是想藏着。如果是那样，我根本就不会告诉你。我只是不太清楚，它对我和其他所有人的关系意味着什么。

lines.en: : Like, Ami calling me “Dad” isn’t going to impact what goes on between you and I unless she walks in on us the next time you need to be {i}distracted.{/i}
lines.zh: : 比如，Ami 叫我「爸爸」并不会影响到你我之间发生的事——除非下次你需要{i}分心{/i}的时候，她正好撞见我们。

lines.en: : Let’s avoid that at all costs, shall we?
lines.zh: : 我们不惜一切代价也要避免那种情况，好吗？

lines.en: : Agreed.
lines.zh: : 同意。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Futaba. There isn’t really {i}one{/i} reason I decided that now was the best time for me to step up. It was closer to a million reasons and...recent developments in my personal life.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Futaba。我决定现在是站出来的最佳时机，并不是因为某{i}一个{/i}理由。更接近于一百万个理由，还有……我私生活中的一些新进展。

lines.en: : Is this about that “person you lost?” The one you told us about in class?
lines.zh: : 是因为你「失去的那个人」吗？就是你在课上跟我们说的那个？

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse14
: Losing people is part of life, I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，失去人是生命的一部分。

lines.en: : I don’t have any experience with that, of course. My parents are still {i}there,{/i} I just can’t contact them at the moment.
lines.zh: : 当然，我在这方面没有任何经验。我爸妈都{i}还在{/i}，我只是现在联系不上他们。

lines.en: : And you’re the first person I’ve ever fallen for, so it’s not like I’ve lost anyone in that regard either.
lines.zh: : 而你是我第一个喜欢上的人，所以在这一方面，我也没有失去过任何人。

lines.en: : But take Nodoka for example. She’s slowly falling out of my life and doesn’t even seem to care at all. And she’s basically always been there, so...that’s a thing I have to just {i}deal with{/i} now.
lines.zh: : 可是拿 Nodoka 来说吧。她正慢慢从我的生命里退场，而且看上去根本一点都不在乎。而她基本上一直都在，所以……这是我现在必须去{i}面对{/i}的事。

lines.en: : And while I don’t really know your circumstances, I can say that having to just {i}look at{/i} that person I’ve lost feels terrible.
lines.zh: : 虽然我不太了解你的处境，但我可以说，只能{i}眼睁睁看着{/i}那个我失去的人，感觉糟透了。

lines.en: : It makes me angry...regretful...and I feel like an idiot a lot of the time for not seeing it coming.
lines.zh: : 那让我愤怒……懊悔……而且很多时候我都觉得自己是个傻瓜，居然没早点看出来。

lines.en: : But even if I loved her...or {i}love{/i} her, despite all that she’s done...I have other people I care about. Just as I’m sure you do.
lines.zh: : 可是就算我爱过她……或者现在{i}还爱着{/i}她，不管她做了什么……我还有别的人在在乎。就像我确信你也有一样。

lines.en: : So maybe it’s best to just let go. Maybe that old phrase really {i}is{/i} accurate after all.
lines.zh: : 所以也许最好的做法就是放手。也许那句老话{i}终究是{/i}对的。

lines.en: : I think Nodoka’s just stubborn, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Nodoka 只是固执，Futaba。

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse15
: I think so too.
lines.zh: : 我也这么觉得。

lines.en: : And deep down, I think she really {i}is{/i} remorseful about this. But she’ll never come out and say that because that’s not the type of person she is.
lines.zh: : 而且在内心深处，我觉得她对此{i}真的{/i}很懊悔。可她永远不会说出口，因为她不是那种人。

lines.en: : You and her are a lot alike. You dodge subjects that you don’t want to confront or make things up because you think it’s easier than holding yourself accountable. But that doesn’t mean you don’t {i}feel{/i} accountable.
lines.zh: : 你和她很像。你们都会躲开自己不想面对的话题，或者编点什么出来，因为你觉得那比承担责任更容易。但那并不代表你心里{i}没有{/i}责任感。

lines.en: : Then...if you know she feels bad, why are you holding it against her? Why not make it easier on her and just bury the hatchet yourself since you’re actually able to?
lines.zh: : 那么……既然你知道她心里不好受，为什么还要一直记着这笔账？为什么不由你主动和解，让她好过一点——毕竟你其实做得到？

lines.en: : Because doing that doesn’t help people grow.
lines.zh: : 因为那样做并不能让人成长。

lines.en: : Nodoka lives in her own world. But that world just happens to be {i}inside{/i} of ours. Or...{i}outside.{/i} It’s kind of hard to tell with her sometimes.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 活在她自己的世界里。只不过那个世界恰好就在我们的世界{i}里面{/i}。或者……{i}外面{/i}。有时候真说不清。

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse16
: And who knows? Maybe I’m wrong and she isn’t actually sorry at all? Maybe I just have a habit of looking for the good in people and...making things up if I can’t find any?
lines.zh: : 而且谁知道呢？也许我错了，她其实一点都不愧疚？也许我只是习惯在人身上找好的一面，然后……找不到的时候就自己编一个？

lines.en: : That’s sort of like what Nodoka and I do then, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那不就有点像我和 Nodoka 做的事了吗？

lines.en: : Yes. But I’m not making things up because I want to avoid confrontation. I’m making things up because I’m naive and optimistic.
lines.zh: : 是的。可我编东西不是因为想逃避冲突。我编，是因为我天真又乐观。

lines.en: : You’d really call yourself an optimist?
lines.zh: : 你真会把自己称作乐观主义者？

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse17
: Would you?
lines.zh: : 你会吗？

lines.en: : About {i}some{/i} things, yes.
lines.zh: : 在{i}某些{/i}事情上，会。

lines.en: : This isn’t about {i}some{/i} things, though. We’re talking about people who dodge confrontation because of certain things they can’t accept. People who hide things because they’re stubborn and habitual.
lines.zh: : 可我们现在谈的不是「{i}某些{/i}事情」。我们谈的是那些因为某些自己无法接受的东西而逃避冲突的人。是那些因为固执和惯性而把事情藏起来的人。

lines.en: : And out of everyone I know...{i}you{/i} are the most consistently negative person, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 而在我认识的所有人里……{i}你{/i}是最稳定地消极的那一个，Futaba。

lines.en: : I’m saying this because I care about you.
lines.zh: : 我说这些是因为我在乎你。

lines.en: : You’re saying it because the alternative is that we talk more about you...but you’re right. Maybe I’m doing the same thing.
lines.zh: : 你说这些，只是因为另一个选项是多聊聊你自己……不过你是对的。也许我也在做同样的事。

lines.en: : I’ve been having a really hard time lately.
lines.zh: : 我最近真的很难熬。

lines.en: : Because of Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 因为 Nodoka？

lines.en: : No. Not because of Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 不。不是因为 Nodoka。

lines.en: : She certainly isn’t helping, though.
lines.zh: : 不过她确实也没帮上什么忙。

lines.en: : Then what? What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 那是因为什么？发生什么了？

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse18
: I’m worried.
lines.zh: : 我在担心。

lines.en: : About your parents?
lines.zh: : 担心你的父母？

lines.en: : About never feeling at home.
lines.zh: : 担心自己永远找不到归属感。

lines.en: : In...what way?
lines.zh: : 在……哪方面？

lines.en: : This body.
lines.zh: : 这具身体。

lines.en: : This curse.
lines.zh: : 这道诅咒。

lines.en: : Like...what if I’m just never content with the way I look?
lines.zh: : 比如……万一我永远都没法满意自己的长相呢？

lines.en: : Because I’ve done everything I can think of and nothing’s improved, Sensei. I’m still horrified whenever I have to look at myself.
lines.zh: : 因为我能想到的一切我都做了，可什么都没改善，Sensei。每次不得不看自己的时候，我还是会感到恐惧。

lines.en: : I exercise. I eat well. I take supplements. I’ve even started taking therapy sessions online and done tons of research on how high the recovery rates are for people with body dysmorphia.
lines.zh: : 我运动。我好好吃饭。我吃保健品。我甚至开始上网做心理咨询，还查了大量关于躯体变形障碍康复率的资料。

lines.en: : It’s like 80%% or something crazy like that. Did you know that? Am I {i}really{/i} going to be part of the 20%%? Is this just how I’m going to have to live the rest of my life?
lines.zh: : 大概是 80%% 之类的，高得离谱。你知道吗？我{i}真的{/i}会成为那 20%% 里的一员吗？这就是我余生必须承受的生活方式吗？

lines.en: : How am I supposed to do that? I’ve barely {i}begun{/i} living.
lines.zh: : 我该怎么过下去？我才{i}刚开始{/i}活着。

lines.en: : Well...how do you expect the rest of us to live with the parts of ourselves that we hate?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那你又指望我们这些人，怎么带着自己讨厌的那部分活下去？

lines.en: : This isn’t just “hating” something, Sensei. I wish it was as simple as that.
lines.zh: : 这不只是「讨厌」某样东西而已，Sensei。我真希望它有那么简单。

lines.en: : It makes me nauseous...seeing myself. It doesn’t matter if it’s a mirror...a picture...hell, even my shadow repulses me. And losing weight was never going to change that. I get that now.
lines.zh: : 看到自己……会让我恶心。不管是镜子……照片……妈的，连我的影子都让我反感。而减肥从来都不可能改变这一点。现在我明白了。

lines.en: : And honestly? I kind of wish I had something terminal sometimes. Because at least {i}then{/i} I’d know where things are headed.
lines.zh: : 而且说实话？有时候我真希望自己得个绝症什么的。因为{i}那样{/i}至少我知道事情会走向何方。

lines.en: : Futaba-
lines.zh: : Futaba——

lines.en: : It’s the truth, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这是事实，Sensei。

lines.en: : Not knowing is what makes all of this so...fucking unbearable. It’s not fair.
lines.zh: : 正是「不知道」让这一切变得这么……他妈的难以忍受。这不公平。

lines.en: : I just want it to end.
lines.zh: : 我只想让它结束。

lines.en: : I just want it to be over.
lines.zh: : 我只想让它过去。

lines.en: : And so sometimes I imagine what that would be like. Or how I would do it.
lines.zh: : 所以有时候我会想象那会是什么样子。或者我会怎么去做。

lines.en: : Or what would become of people like Rin or Nodoka or my family or {i}you.{/i} And that calms me down a little.
lines.zh: : 或者像 Rin、Nodoka、我的家人，还有{i}你{/i}这样的人会变成什么样。而那会让我稍微冷静一点。

lines.en: : I love all of you guys. It’s myself that I can’t stomach.
lines.zh: : 我爱你们所有人。我受不了的只是我自己。

lines.en: : So please continue to be kind to me, as I am only reluctantly here.
lines.zh: : 所以请继续对我好一点吧，毕竟我只是勉强地留在这儿。

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse19
: It’s really that bad?...
lines.zh: : 真的这么严重吗？……

lines.en: : I don’t think anything I can say will ever do justice to how bad it actually is. And I’m well aware that I probably sound really immature for even complaining about this right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得无论我说什么，都不足以形容它到底有多严重。而且我很清楚，现在居然还抱怨这个，听起来大概相当幼稚。

lines.en: : Not at all...
lines.zh: : 一点都不……

lines.en: : So yeah, that’s where my mind has been lately. Not very fun.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我最近脑子里想的就是这些。一点也不好玩。

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse20
: Yeah, it doesn’t sound like it would be...
lines.zh: : 嗯，听起来确实不会好玩……

lines.en: : There will always be distractions, I guess. And if that’s just how I have to live the rest of my life so I can avoid confronting reality, whatever.
lines.zh: : 我想，分心的东西总会有的。如果那就是我为了逃避面对现实而不得不过完余生的方式，那也随它去吧。

lines.en: : You were right to call me out. I have no place to say that you or Nodoka shouldn’t hide in places that make you comfortable when I’d absolutely do the same if I could only {i}find{/i} one.
lines.zh: : 你点破我是对的。我根本没有资格说你和 Nodoka 不该躲进让自己舒服的地方——只要我{i}找得到{/i}那样的地方，我绝对也会这么做。

lines.en: : The closest I’ve got is you — who won’t ever see the same Futaba that I see. And that makes me happy, really.
lines.zh: : 我找到的最接近那种地方的东西就是你——而你永远看不到我眼中的那个 Futaba。而这真的让我高兴。

lines.en: : I just wish I knew what it was like. I wish I could understand the way other people see me.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望自己知道那是什么感觉。我希望自己能理解别人眼中的我。

lines.en: : I can relate to you there.
lines.zh: : 这一点我能感同身受。

lines.en: : And I wish I could do more, but it doesn’t seem like I can...
lines.zh: : 我也希望自己能多做点什么，但看起来我做不到……

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse21
: I don’t think you can, either.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你也做不到。

lines.en: : Ahh...this sucks. We’re together again after so long. I wish I could be happier.
lines.zh: : 啊……真糟。隔了这么久我们又在一起了。我真希望自己能更开心一点。

lines.en: : We could always have sex again.
lines.zh: : 我们随时可以再做一次。

lines.en: : Can we? Don’t you have an early shift at the tire factory tomorrow?
lines.zh: : 可以吗？你明天不是还要一早去轮胎工厂上班？

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse22
: I can call out.
lines.zh: : 我可以请假。

lines.en: : Not because you’re going to kill yourself, I hope.
lines.zh: : 希望你不是因为要去自杀才请的。

lines.en: : Are {i}you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}是吗？

lines.en: : Nah. Rin would get mad.
lines.zh: : 不是。Rin 会生气的。

lines.en: : So would I.
lines.zh: : 我也会。

lines.en: : But would you disappear for another three months like you did for the last person? Or am I not {i}that{/i} important to you?
lines.zh: : 可你会不会又消失三个月，就像你为上一个那个人做的那样？还是说，我对你来说没{i}那么{/i}重要？

lines.en: scene futabanighttraipse23
: Is that...a serious question?
lines.zh: : 这……是个认真的问题吗？

lines.en: : Of course not, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 当然不是，Sensei。

lines.en: scene black
: I already know the answer.
lines.zh: : 我已经知道答案了。

lines.en: I take her home and lay her down on the bed.
lines.zh: 我把她带回家，让她躺在床上。

lines.en: She does not call me “Daddy” this time — she just locks her eyes on mine and doesn’t look away until I feed her once more.
lines.zh: 这一次她没有叫我「爸爸」——她只是把目光锁在我身上，直到我再喂她一次都没有移开。

lines.en: They lack the life they once had, but I don’t think it’s my fault this time.
lines.zh: 那双眼睛失去了曾经拥有的生机，但这一次我不觉得那是我的错。

lines.en: I think that sometimes, there are just people who are meant to get lost.
lines.zh: 我觉得，有时候就是有些人注定要迷失。

lines.en: But that’s okay, because...
lines.zh: 但那没关系，因为……

lines.en: Huh.
lines.zh: 嗯。

lines.en: {i}Why{/i} is it okay, exactly?
lines.zh: 可到底{i}为什么{/i}没关系？

lines.en: Either way, I leave once Futaba falls asleep.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，等 Futaba 睡着之后我就离开了。

lines.en: And while I managed not to get into any of the specifics about why things are the way they are for me now, I found something horrible in the process.
lines.zh: 虽然我成功避开了任何关于我现在的处境为何如此的具体细节，但在这个过程中，我发现了一件可怕的事。

lines.en: But it’s one of those things you can’t change.
lines.zh: 可那是你无法改变的那种事。

lines.en: And I don’t know if that makes me feel better or worse.
lines.zh: 而我也不知道那让我感觉更好还是更糟。
